name: Kbd
description: Draws a keyboard key on a keycap, alone or as one shortcut.

children.description: The key as it is printed: a glyph or a short word

label.description: The key's spoken name for a glyph a screen reader cannot say. The glyph is then hidden from assistive tech.

when: Showing the keyboard shortcut for an action
Naming a key inside help copy
A shortcut hint in a menu row, tooltip or field
whenNot: Inline code or a command to copy — use CodeBlock or Text type="code"
A status or count — use Badge
Anything clickable — keys are hints, not buttons
guidelines: One key per Kbd; the keys of one shortcut go in Kbd.Group
Glyph keys carry a label so they are spoken by name
Print the platform's own glyphs (⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere)
accessibility: Renders native kbd elements; a shortcut is a kbd that holds kbds
label hides the glyph and speaks the name instead

examples.name: Key
examples.description: One key, printed as a word.

examples.name: Shortcut
examples.description: The keys of one shortcut, the glyph spoken by name.

relations.note: A tooltip names an action and shows its shortcut as a Kbd
A menu row shows its shortcut as a Kbd on the trailing edge

propsSummary: children: ReactNode - the key as printed (required)
label: string - the spoken name of a glyph key
